parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom supporting part of the storage cabinet, made of plywood for structural stability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the entire cabinet structure and bears the load of stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a flat MDF panel attached to the front of the cabinet with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the storage space inside the cabinet by swinging open and closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding compartment made of plywood, located at the top of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a small, easily accessible storage space for utensils or small items.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along metal or wooden rails.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main body structure of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the door, drawer, and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structure and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a horizontal plywood board inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space into sections for organized storage.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height.
